# Signal loss

Brief digital dropouts: now and then the picture freezes on its last good frame (or falls to noise), torn by bands of static, then recovers.

<EffectDemo effect="signal-loss" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { signalLoss } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/signal-loss';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(signalLoss({ preset: 'satellite' }));
// Animated effects hold still until play() (or { autoplay: true }).
composer.play();
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.frequency = 0.5`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter             | Type                | Default    | Range      | Description                                                                   |
| --------------------- | ------------------- | ---------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `frequency`           | number              | `0.5`      | 0 – 1      | Chances per second of a dropout (at most one a second, for photosensitivity). |
| `chance`              | number              | `0.6`      | 0 – 1      | Probability that each chance turns into a dropout.                            |
| `duration`            | number              | `0.4`      | 0.05 – 1 s | Length of each dropout.                                                       |
| `mode` _(structural)_ | 'freeze' \| 'noise' | `'freeze'` |            | Freeze on the last good frame, or fall to noise.                              |
| `severity`            | number              | `0.6`      | 0 – 1      | How much static and block damage covers the dropout.                          |
| `seed`                | integer             | `0`        | 0 – 99     | Picks a different schedule of dropouts.                                       |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset       | Settings                                           |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `satellite`  | `frequency: 0.6`, `duration: 0.6`, `severity: 0.8` |
| `rare`       | `frequency: 0.25`, `chance: 0.5`, `duration: 0.3`  |
| `freezeOnly` | `severity: 0`                                      |
| `noise`      | `mode: 'noise'`, `duration: 0.25`                  |

Apply one with `signalLoss({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Glitch & signal · tracked as story X6.10 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass. It also renders its own intermediate passes before the merged pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Freezes: when motion is off (reduced motion, high contrast or `composer.motion = false`) the effect holds its current frame.
- **Size:** 7.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/signal-loss`, including the shared effect runtime.

Original implementation (MIT). References: Digital dropouts: frozen frames with static bands and block damage on a hashed schedule.

## Related

- [Datamosh](./datamosh) — The look of a video with its keyframes removed: motion drags the old picture along in blocks, smearing it into the new one until the next keyframe resets it.
- [Digital noise](./digital-noise) — Video static: mono or color noise that changes every frame, with occasional stronger horizontal bands.
- [Scanline tear](./scanline-tear) — Bands of scanlines slip sideways and wrap around, with an optional sinusoidal wobble, like a TV losing horizontal sync.
